project.title: Single-stage microbial conversion of fish waste into linear and branched medium-chain fatty acids
project.description: The study investigated the valorization of fish waste into medium-chain fatty acids (MCFAs) through mono- and co-fermentation in a single-stage process. It characterized and compared MCFA yields and microbial ecology under ammonia stress, which arose from amino acid degradation during both fermentation approaches.
